concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) defines **Phase 1 – Data Ingestion**, but the tasks document has no tasks explicitly assigned to this phase. All ingestion‑related tasks are placed under Phase 3 (User Story 1). Add at least one task (e.g., T0xx) under a dedicated Phase 1 section to satisfy the plan’s phase mapping.

The plan (plan.md) includes a separate **Phase 2 – Power Analysis**, yet the tasks file only contains power‑analysis work in Phase 0 (Task T000a). Create a distinct Phase 2 section with a task (e.g., T0xx) that performs the a‑priori power analysis and records the required sample size, matching the plan’s structure.

Task ID **T058** appears twice (once for pre‑flight URL verification and again later for the same purpose). This violates the uniqueness constraint enforced by task T099a and creates ambiguity for automation. Rename one of the duplicates (e.g., to T058a) and update all internal references.

Task ID **T020** is used for both the Pearson correlation computation and the synthetic dataset generation, causing a conflict. Resolve the clash by renaming the synthetic‑dataset task (e.g., T020a) and adjusting any dependent references.
